judgements.justification: Only A heard the authors concede that a tuned Transformer beats the model by 3 to 4 BLEU on MT; Reviewer_fSHR then raised to 7 and A's AC called the results 'strong' and gave a spotlight.
No reviewer raised a new objection or lowered a score after the response period; the only late change, Reviewer_fSHR's on 2021-09-10, was a raise.
The scores are not near-identical (A 7.5 with a 9, B 6.75 with two 6s), and A's AC followed one reviewer's framing, not a bare threshold on scores.
B's most specific reviewer, Reviewer_3r7i (8, confidence 4, engaged after the rebuttal), is neither cited nor weighed in B's meta-review, which follows the 6.75 mean to a poster.
The rebuttal lifted scores in both committees (A's Reviewer_fSHR to 7, B's two reviewers to 6), and B's answerable concerns did not lift B above A.
A's outlying 9 from Reviewer_e5Ff lifted A's mean from 7.0 to 7.5 and carried the spotlight, while A's other scores (7, 7, 7) match B's (6, 8, 7, 6) closely.
A's outlying Reviewer_e5Ff posted nothing after the rebuttal, which disclosed that a Transformer beats the model on MT, the claim behind its 9, so the 9 stood unrevised.
Neither committee had a low-scoring detractor; both accepted unanimously.
No reviewer or AC in either committee raised audience breadth or venue fit.
A's meta-review omits the Transformer concession rather than misreporting reviewers' positions, and B's 'All reviewers agree the acceptance' is accurate.
In A two of four reviewers (Reviewer_fSHR, Reviewer_6KbN) engaged after the rebuttal, and in B all four did, so neither committee's majority left it unanswered.
B's non-expert Reviewer_LKem gave 7, but without it B's mean is 6.67, so it did not lift B's mean or tier, and A's reviewers did not disclaim expertise.
Both committees accepted unanimously; there was no even split for an AC to settle.
The authors conceded the Transformer's 3 to 4 BLEU lead only to A and gave the favourable pipelined and no-constraint tables only to B, so each committee judged different evidence.
No novelty verdict rested on a wrong account of prior work; B's reviewers correctly challenged the paper's description of NQG-T5.
A's spotlight is argued in its meta-review ('strong results', sample efficiency) and backed by a 7.5 mean with a 9.
No reviewer objected to the paper's framing from a neighbouring field's premises.
The engaged champion, Reviewer_3r7i (8), sat on B, the lower committee, so the mechanism does not explain B's lower tier.
Neither committee rejected the paper or judged the promised revisions too large for camera-ready.
Both meta-reviews rest on the visible reviews and scores; no off-record input is cited.
Both committees judged the paper as a method contribution on the same benchmarks; neither applied a different standard for its contribution type.
No reviewer held a below-threshold score after the rebuttal; B's lowest final scores are 6, above the acceptance threshold.
